{{Expand German|topic=bio|Gabriele_Sadowski|date=May 2019}}

'''Gabriele Sadowski''' (born 18 February 1964) is a German chemist.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.awk.nrw.de/akademie/klassen/ingenieurwirtschaft/ordentliche-mitglieder/sadowski-gabriele.html|title=AWK: Sadowski, Gabriele|website=www.awk.nrw.de|access-date=2018-12-15|archive-date=2016-05-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160502014028/http://www.awk.nrw.de/akademie/klassen/ingenieurwirtschaft/ordentliche-mitglieder/sadowski-gabriele.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Sadowski studied chemistry at [[Technische Universität Leuna-Merseburg]] from 1982 to 1987.<ref name=":0" /> She finished her doctorate in 1991 at [[Technische Universität Leuna-Merseburg]].<ref name=":0" /> She completed her dissertation at [[Technische Universität Berlin]] in 2000.<ref name=":0" />

== Career and research ==
Her research focuses on Polymer [[Thermodynamics]], Thermodynamics of Pharmaceutical Systems, and Reaction Thermodynamics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.th.bci.tu-dortmund.de/cms/de/Mitarbeiterinfo/Sadowski_CV_2016.pdf|title=CV Sadowski|last=|first=|date=|website=www.th.bci.tu-dortmund.de|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref> Since 2001, she is full professor at [[TU Dortmund University]].<ref name=":0" /> She took over the responsibility of prorector research in 2016.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.tu-dortmund.de/en/university/organization/rectorate/prorector-research/?L=0|title=Prorector Research|website=TU Dortmund|language=en|access-date=2019-03-07}}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==
She was awarded the [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dfg.de/gefoerderte_projekte/wissenschaftliche_preise/leibniz-preis/2011/sadowski/index.jsp|title=DFG – Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft – Prof. Dr. Gabriele Sadowski – Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz-Preisträgerin 2011|website=www.dfg.de|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref> in 2011 and she is a member of the North Rhine-Westphalian Academy of Sciences, Humanities and the Arts.<ref name=":0" />
